newsitem.title: USA: Abraxas says units acquire Canadian parcel.
newsitem.headline: Abraxas says units acquire Canadian parcel.

text.p: Abraxas Petroleum Corp said Monday its Canandian subsidiaries acquired 116,845 acres in the Central MacKenzie Valley for a total work commitment of $2.2 million.
Abraxas said its partially owned Cascade Oil & Gas Ltd will own a 20 percent interest in the parcel, and will manage the effort to explore it.
Abraxas said its wholly-owned subsidiary Canadian Abraxas Petroleum Ltd owns 80 percent.
Abraxas said the lands adjoin the Norman Wells Field, which is an oil producing field in Canada.
The company said the Norman Wells pipeline to northwest Alberta crosses its parcel.
The company said it plans to be prepared to acquire new seismic data during the 1997-1998 winter activity period.
